QuestInfo.name: I am Mo Xuan
QuestInfo.0: The power of Wu Shen almost feels like it's part of you.
QuestInfo.2:
After finding the records of Wu Shen in the Devil Clan Stronghold, you tossed them to the flames. 
You are different from Wu Shen... There is no need to worry about what he would have done. 
You vow to walk the path that you think is right, with no regrets. 
You will write your own destiny.
